class_pooling: maximum of device whistle and human whistling
selection: Calibrate each detector threshold on match1 only. Compare on match2; freeze the chosen detector before evaluating match3 once.
scope: Cross-sport whistle-event pilot, not possession labels or football stoppage validation.
context_rationale: Two seconds covers the approximately 3.48-second CNN temporal receptive field around central scored frames; fixed before inference.
chunk_rationale: 1024 output frames align successive chunks to the CNN stride of 32 frames; chosen from architecture before inference.
